notifications.title: An army from Snovsk starved
notifications.body: With no food left it scattered; none of them will come back.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 40 of them against its guard of 37.

notifications.title: Spring has come
notifications.body: The thaw: the land wakes, and every front stirs alike.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (2, -3)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 3850 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: The captives at (1, -1) were taken away
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +80% attack and defense.

notifications.title: The Holy City was struck
notifications.body: Its Sanctity fell to 80.

notifications.title: Winter has come
notifications.body: Snow on the fields: no grain at all, the stores must last. The Monsters of the North come twice as often.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (0, 6)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 3500 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the south.

notifications.title: The forbidding ruin at (-7, 4) sank back into the earth
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +60% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Achievement: Into the Den
notifications.body: Clear a lair of Nav.

notifications.title: Your army cleared the lair at (3, -4)
notifications.body: It sends home 371 resources, and a Svarog's Ember for the group.

notifications.title: Done: Clear your first camp
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: Snovsk held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten after 3 rounds.

notifications.title: Achievement: Shield of the Village
notifications.body: Beat a horde at one of your villages.

notifications.title: Achievement: Many Banners
notifications.body: Stand against two hordes in one battle.

notifications.title: Another horde joins the battle at (-2, 2)
notifications.body: 13 more from the south fight alongside the horde already there.

notifications.title: A horde is coming to Snovsk
notifications.body: The low south horde arrives within the hour. Check the garrison and its stance.

notifications.title: Autumn has come
notifications.body: The harvest is in and the ground is firm: every soldier holds 20% better. The Order marches half as often again; the nomads go home to winter.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (1, -1)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 3150 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: The captives at (-8, 5) were taken away
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +40% attack and defense.

notifications.title: The Holy City held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten at its walls after 2 rounds.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 40 of them against its guard of 33.

notifications.title: A lair in the woods
notifications.body: Beasts of the North have made a lair by the road their last horde took. The Iron Span needs it cleared.

notifications.title: The Smith-Breakers gather
notifications.body: Nav knows the forge is lit. The Smith-Breakers, a host sworn to put out Svarog's flame, march on the Holy City apart from the hordes: beat them before the walls, and the iron can be forged.

notifications.title: Achievement: Stone upon Stone
notifications.body: Raise a stage of the Kalinov Bridge.

notifications.title: The Oak Piers stands
notifications.body: The builders send 600 wood, 600 stone, 600 grain and 300 iron, and the Blessing of the Bridge Wrights is on every village of the group. Next: The Iron Span.

notifications.title: Snovsk is under attack
notifications.body: A horde of 9 is fighting your garrison of 8.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 9 of them against its guard of 30.

notifications.title: A horde is coming to Snovsk
notifications.body: The low north horde arrives within the hour. Check the garrison and its stance.

notifications.title: Raising The Oak Piers
notifications.body: Everything it needs is in place; the builders are at work.

notifications.title: Nav strikes at the builders
notifications.body: While The Oak Piers is raised, a band sets out against every village of the group.

notifications.title: Summer has come
notifications.body: The fields ripen: twice the grain. The steppe riders ride twice as often; the Order's armies, slow in the heat, half as often.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (-7, 4)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 2800 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the north.

notifications.title: The forbidding ruin at (3, -1) sank back into the earth
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: The forbidding ruin at (1, -5) sank back into the earth
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +40% attack and defense.
